claims.claim: AeroVironment reported fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $480.5M, up 6% year over year, and in September disclosed a nearly $500M U.S. Army counter-UAS directed-energy contract plus a >$50M first international LOCUST order.

risks.risk: Defense-program concentration, integration complexity and contract timing can make growth lumpy.

unknowns.unknown: Post-BlueHalo organic growth, margins and cash conversion require Alpha underwriting.

claims.claim: Recent counter-UAS and directed-energy awards materially expand the delivery burden; execution now depends on converting large awards into scaled production while integrating BlueHalo capabilities.

risks.risk: Capacity expansion and acquisition integration can pressure margins if program ramps slip.

unknowns.unknown: Program-level margin and delivery cadence are not established here.
